title: EP 564 Validate Digital Products Before You Build | AI Entrepreneur Plan
promo_conflict: The speaker promotes a free weekend validation worksheet in the show notes; no paid offer or material conflict is disclosed.

stated_problem.quote: Solo bookkeepers who lose 2 hours every month end chasing client receipts.
stated_problem.speaker: Tracy

idea.name: Month-end receipt rescue kit
idea.one_liner: A $19 digital kit for solo bookkeepers, with client email sequences, a receipt checklist and a policy to help with month-end receipt chasing.
idea.offer: Three copy-and-paste client email sequences, a receipt request checklist and a one-page policy to send to new clients.
idea.revenue_model: One-time sale of a digital product; the $19 price is presented as an example.

key_quotes.quote: The month-end receipt rescue kit for solo bookkeepers tired of chasing client receipts.
The kit ships on and give them a specific date.
Not join my newsletter, instead get the receipt rescue kit at launch price when it's ready.

claims.claim: The example buyer persona loses two hours every month end chasing receipts.
claims.quote: Solo bookkeepers who lose 2 hours every month end chasing client receipts.

claims.claim: The example kit is priced at $19.
claims.quote: The month-end receipt rescue kit for solo bookkeepers tired of chasing client receipts. You're going to get three copy and paste client email sequences, a receipt request checklist, and a one-page policy you can send to new clients all built to help you cut your month-end chase time and it's only $19.

acquisition_channels.details: The speaker suggests messaging 10–20 matching buyers in relevant communities and leading with a question; the specific messaging service is not stated.
Share the landing page where the buyer already spends time, when promotion is allowed.
Use a landing page with a pre-sale or specific email waitlist; the traffic source is not specified.

ideas.delivery: A digital kit containing copy-and-paste emails, a checklist and a policy that bookkeepers can send to their clients. The delivery platform is not stated.

uk_legal_risk.reason: The suggested outreach is to message matching solo bookkeepers in relevant communities. If that means unsolicited social DMs to sole traders or individuals for marketing, UK PECR prohibits it.

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies if collecting waitlist email addresses; provide appropriate privacy information and handle the data lawfully.
